name: Shidou Risa
source: Hiroki's another childhood friend who, after reuniting with him, is mad at him for some reason and isn't the same nice girl she used to be. Risa used to play with both him and [url=/c34745]Misato[/url] on a daily basis, however, she had to move because of her parents' work. Maybe her being angry at Hiroki has something to do with the childhood promise of getting married with him...
